documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a remarkable financial performance for FY26, achieving record-high production, sales volumes, revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by growth strategies and operational efficiency. The company expanded its lead recycling capacity by 55% at the TKD facility and doubled its copper recycling capacity in Q4 FY26. Furthermore, the Board approved a 36,000 metric tons per annum copper cathode plant at the TKD facility with an estimated investment of INR 200 crores, funded through internal accruals. Management also provided positive volume growth outlooks and capacity utilization expectations for both the lead and copper segments for the upcoming years. Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited reported landmark financial performance for FY26 with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by higher production and sales volumes across lead and copper segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins above 8% and return on capital employed above 20% under its Target 2030 aspiration.
guidance.quote: Our growth is complemented by a strong focus on margin expansion with targets maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and return on capital employed above 20%.

guidance.claim: Management targets 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability.
guidance.quote: We continue to expand our lead and copper capacities while strengthening our presence across adjacent nonferrous recycling segments to deliver 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company aims to derive over 60% of revenue from value-added products over the long term.
guidance.quote: At the same time, we remain committed to enhancing operational efficiency through innovation, modernization and increased value addition with the goal of deriving over 60% of revenue from value-added products.

guidance.claim: Management expects lead volumes to reach around 125,000 to 130,000 tons for the current year.
guidance.quote: And if we're able to push it up, we can -- we will try to reach slightly higher. But as of now, the guidance that we can look at about 125,000 to 130,000.

guidance.claim: Management targets a utilization of approximately 70% to 75% for the new plant capacity.
guidance.quote: And we are looking at a utilization of approximately close to 70% on the new plant capacity -- 70% to 75%.

guidance.claim: The company expects capital expenditure to be approximately INR 180 crores to INR 200 crores for the financial year.
guidance.quote: For the current year, our capex will be well within number -- approximately around INR 180 crores will be the capex – INR 180 crores to INR 200 crores for this financial year.

guidance.claim: The company aims to sustain 15%+ volume growth, deliver 20%+ revenue CAGR, maintain EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%, while increasing value-added products contribution to over 60%.
guidance.quote: The Company aims to sustain 15%+ volume growth, deliver 20%+ revenue CAGR, maintain EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%, while increasing the contribution of value-added products to over 60%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that blended margins will remain in the range of 7% to 8%.
guidance.quote: So the blended margins will remain in the range of 7% to 8%.

guidance.claim: The company targets maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%.
guidance.quote: Growth will be supported by margin improvement with a focus on maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve over 60% revenue contribution from value-added products and a 20% plus reduction in energy consumption.
guidance.quote: Alongside scale and strategy emphasis, operational efficiency through innovation and modernization with a target of over 60% revenue contribution from value-added products and 20% plus reduction in energy consumption, backed by a net cash balance sheet, disciplined execution, a supportive regulatory environment, extensive land bank, experienced leadership and stakeholder support.

guidance.claim: The company targets delivering 20% plus volume growth and 20% plus CAGR in revenue and profitability.
guidance.quote: The company continues to scale its lead and copper capacities while expanding into adjacent non-ferrous segments with an objective of delivering 20% plus volume growth and 20% plus CAGR in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: Management stated that lead capacities are expected to ramp up to 70% in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The lead capacities are expected to ramp up to 70% in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: For FY '27, the company is targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons in copper.
guidance.quote: FY '27, we are targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons but would be definitely higher than that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the India-EU trade deal secures long-term demand visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: I would want to mention that the India-EU trade deal serves as a structural catalyst for POCL, enhancing our global price competitiveness, securing long-term demand visibility and solidifying our status as an organized compliant leader capable of meeting Europe's rigorous sustainability standards.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that market demand in the last quarter was on the softer side, along with softer prices and offtakes.
demand_outlook.quote: But currently, what we saw in the last quarter, the whole market demand was pretty much on the softer side, along with softer prices and offtakes as well.

demand_outlook.claim: For lead, the company looks at anywhere between 5% to 6% of incremental demand in India, and 2% to 3% internationally.
demand_outlook.quote: For India, we are looking at anywhere between 5%, 6% of incremental demand and also the demand that comes from your regular replacement demand of existing batteries and vehicles. And internationally, about 2% to 3% is the growth.

capex_expansion.claim: POCL enhanced its lead recycling capacity at the TKD facility by 55%, increasing it from 132,000 to 204,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, POCL enhanced its lead recycling capacity at the TKD facility by 55%, increasing it from 132,000 metric tons per annum to 204,000 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company doubled its copper recycling capacity to 12,000 metric tons per annum in Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We also successfully doubled our copper recycling capacity to 12,000 metric tons per annum in Q4 FY '26, reinforcing our presence in the Copper Recycling segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved setting up a 36,000 metric tons per annum copper cathode plant at the TKD facility with an estimated investment of INR 200 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our growth platform, the Board has approved the setting up of a 36,000 metric tons per annum copper cathode plant at our TKD facility in Tamil Nadu with an estimated investment of approximately INR 200 crores, funded purely through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The copper cathode plant project will be implemented in 2 phases of 18,000 metric tons per annum each, with Phase 1 targeted for commissioning by December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The project will be implemented in 2 phases of 18,000 metric tons per annum each and Phase 1 is targeted for commissioning by December 2026, which marks a significant step in expanding our nonferrous recycling portfolio and enhancing value-added capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: POCL deployed approximately INR 49 crores towards capital expenditure in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Backing our growth strategy, POCL deployed approximately INR 49 crores towards capital expenditure in FY '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to incur an additional INR 180 crores in FY27 for capacity augmentation and other initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing for future and expect to incur additional INR 180 crores in FY '27 to support capacity augmentation in copper, downstream integration and other strategic growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Successfully commissioned commercial production under Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Lead capacity expansion project, contributing 36,000 MTPA each in April'25 and Dec'25, respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: Successfully commissioned commercial production under Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Lead capacity expansion project, contributing 36,000 MTPA each in April’25 and Dec’25, respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully doubled its Copper Recycling capacity to 12,000 MTPA in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Successfully doubled Copper Recycling capacityto12,000 MTPAinFY26.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex of Rs. 49 Cr. was incurred in FY26, with estimated capex for FY27 at Rs. 180 Cr.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of Rs.49 Cr. done inFY26; EstimatedCapexfor FY27 Rs.180 Cr.

capex_expansion.claim: The second phase of the lead expansion project adding 36,000 metric tons per annum was commissioned and became operational in December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The second phase of lead expansion project, adding 36,000 metric tons per annum was commissioned and became operational in December 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Total lead capacity increased from 132,000 metric tons per annum in FY '25 to 2,04,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: As a result, the total lead capacity has increased from 132,000 metric tons per annum in FY '25 to 2,04,000 metric tons per annum, representing an increase of over 50%.

capex_expansion.claim: Copper recycling capacity is set to double from 6,000 metric tons per annum to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of Jan 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our copper recycling capacity is set to double from 6,000 metric tons per annum to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of Jan 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: POCL's Board has approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, POCL Future Tech into the parent company.
capex_expansion.quote: POCL's Board has approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, POCL Future Tech into the parent company, subject to regulatory approvals.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton of lead improved significantly by 39% to INR 18,462 in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA per ton of lead improved significantly by 39% to INR 18,462 in FY '26 and by 43% year-on-year to INR 19,739 during the quarter, reflecting the success of our value optimization synergies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 212 basis points to 7.4% in FY26 compared to 5.3% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 212 basis points to 7.4% in FY '26, compared to 5.3% in FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton of lead increased significantly by 46% year-on-year to INR 18,086 per ton on a 9-month basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per ton of lead increased significantly by 46% year-on-year to INR 18,086 per ton on a 9-month basis by 39% year-on-year to INR 17,427 per ton on a quarterly basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins remained strong at over 7% plus compared to over 5% in 9 months FY '25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained strong at over 7% plus compared to over 5% in 9 months FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that INR 15,000 to INR 17,500 is a sustainable EBITDA per ton for lead irrespective of price movement.
margins_costs.quote: INR 15,000 to INR 17,500 is something what we have -- it's a sustainable EBITDA per ton irrespective of the price movement.

margins_costs.claim: For copper recycling, the EBITDA per ton is in the range of INR 35,000 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: Right now, for the recycling, it is in the range of INR 35,000 per ton...

orders_capacity.claim: Lead production and sales increased by 11% each in FY26 to 104,481 metric tons and 100,727 metric tons respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: Lead production and sales increased by 11% each in FY '26 to 104,481 metric tons and 100,727 metric tons, respectively, on a quarterly basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales witnessed a significant increase in FY26, growing by nearly 11x to INR 673 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Copper sales witnessed a significant increase in FY '26, growing by nearly 11x to INR 673 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The volume sales for copper is about 1,235 metric tons for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Dheeraj, the volume sales for copper is about 1,235 metric tons for this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall lead capacity utilization for the 9 months ended is about 70%, and for the quarter alone it is about 79.2%.
orders_capacity.quote: See, overall, if you see the lead capacity utilization for this 9 months ended is about 70%. And for this quarter alone, it is about 79.2%.

orders_capacity.claim: For copper, 9-month capacity utilization is about 74% and for the quarter it's about 86.2%.
orders_capacity.quote: For copper for 9 months about 74% and for this quarter, it's about 86.2% on an overall basis for this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Production of lead increased by 23% year-on-year to 83,746 metric tons on a 9-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: The production of lead has increased by 23% year-on-year to 83,746 metric tons on a 9-month basis and 57% year-on-year and 26% quarter-on-quarter to 33,271 metric tons on a quarterly basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The 9-month overall volume for copper is about 3,308 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: 9 months overall volume is about 3,308 metric tons, out of which 6,000 is the overall capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per equity share, representing 100% of the face value for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with its commitment to reward the shareholders, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per equity share, representing 100% of the face value for FY 2025 - 26.

capital_allocation.claim: The merger of POCL Future Tech into the parent company improves cost efficiency and cash flow management without equity dilution or cash outflow.
capital_allocation.quote: The merger strengthens vertical integration in plastic recycling, improves cost efficiency and cash flow management and creates long-term value for POCL without any equity dilution or cash outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash on the books as on December end is about INR 35 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that sailing days for raw material shipments have increased by 10 to 15 days due to the Middle East conflict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Definitely, there have been, in fact, the sailing days have increased in terms of when the vessel arrives versus by 10, 15 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the copper market is going through an extremely volatile phase with vertical price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The copper, as you are noticing, the whole copper market is going through extremely volatile phase. And when any metal, which almost close to 40%, 45% just shoots up in a vertical manner, overall industry, it takes a little bit of time and momentum for it to absorb these kind of price increases and which have to flow down eventually to the end consumers.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the 36,000 MTPA copper cathode plant is targeted for commissioning by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The project will be implemented in 2 phases of 18,000 metric tons per annum each and Phase 1 is targeted for commissioning by December 2026, which marks a significant step in expanding our nonferrous recycling portfolio and enhancing value-added capabilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur an additional INR 180 crores in FY27 to support strategic growth initiatives.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing for future and expect to incur additional INR 180 crores in FY '27 to support capacity augmentation in copper, downstream integration and other strategic growth initiatives.

management_commitments.claim: The newly doubled copper recycling facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability under its Target 2030 aspiration.
management_commitments.quote: In conclusion, POCL remains firmly on track to achieve its Target 2030 aspiration guided by a clear and disciplined strategy focused on sustainable growth, operational excellence and long-term value creation. We continue to expand our lead and copper capacities while strengthening our presence across adjacent nonferrous recycling segments to deliver 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains firmly on track towards achieving its Target 2030, with strategic focus on capacity expansion across Lead, Copper, and other key segments.
management_commitments.quote: POCL remains firmly on track towards achieving its Target 2030, with a strategic focus on capacity expansion across Lead, Copper, and other key segments.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the copper recycling capacity is set to double to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of Jan 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Our copper recycling capacity is set to double from 6,000 metric tons per annum to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of Jan 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that they will be looking into Mundra only in 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So Sagar, currently, as indicated earlier as well, we will be looking into Mundra only in 2027.

management_commitments.claim: For FY '27, the company is targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons in copper.
management_commitments.quote: FY '27, we are targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons but would be definitely higher than that.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
